Replace the signing key of a webhook

Replace the signing key of a webhook. The old key stops at once: the receiver
rejects every delivery until it has the new key, so rp asks for confirmation
(--yes in a script).

A webhook signs each delivery with its key (the X-Repsy-Signature header).
The key is shown ONCE, when the webhook is created or its key rotated: rp prints
it on stdout only when you ask for it with --show-secret (the bare key) or with
a structured --output or --jq. Store it in the receiver right away.

```
rp webhook rotate <repo> <id> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --show-secret   Print the signing key on stdout (once); implied by a structured --output
```
